question_summary: Contractor requests approval to substitute ABS DWV piping in lieu of the no-hub cast-iron soil piping specified in Section 22 13 16 prior to placing a material order.
proposed_solution: Use ABS DWV piping in lieu of no-hub cast-iron soil piping.
deadline_text: A response by the end of the day would let us keep the order on track.
routing_rationale: The request involves a material substitution for specified soil piping, which falls under plumbing design authority and code compliance review.
